# BAST — Handover Acceptance Report — {PROJECT_NAME}

> **Output file location:** `docs/pm/BAST.md`.
> **When to fill:** after Release (Column 9 in `DEVELOPMENT_STAGE_GUIDE.md`) is complete and the
> production smoke test passes — NOT before that. A BAST signed before the system is actually
> live is a promise, not evidence of handover.
> **Formality scale:** see table below — solo/internal may use a brief version.

---

## Formality scale by project type

| Element | Solo/personal | Internal | Client-facing | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Format | Skip — not needed | Email/ticket confirmation | Written document + signature | Written document + signature + notarization/legal review |
| Signatories | — | PM + manager | PM + named client PIC | PM + sponsor + legal/procurement |
| Required attachments | — | Link to deliverables | All attachments below | All attachments + audit trail |

> ⚠️ **BAST is not a legal document generated by AI and does NOT constitute formal legal advice.** For high-value projects, contractual handovers, or those at risk of
> dispute, this template is an operational starting point — have it reviewed by licensed legal counsel before using
> as a binding contract. See `SKILL.md § Legal & Compliance Disclaimer` and `engine/NUMERIC_STANDARDS.md § Legal & Regulatory Disclaimers`.

> **For `handover_formality: legal` projects:** Gate C (Project Closed) is **blocked** until a
> human with legal or procurement authority reviews and signs this document. The agent cannot
> self-certify this review. Record the reviewer in CONTEXT.md as `legal_reviewed_by` and
> `legal_review_date` before marking the project closed. See `modules/04-closure.md § QC3`.

## Handover Statement

On {YYYY-MM-DD}, the delivering party has completed and delivered
the work in accordance with {Project Charter / SoW / contract number ___}, and the receiving party
declares having inspected and accepted the work under the following conditions:

**Status:** Accepted in full / Accepted with notes / Accepted conditionally (see Open Items)

## Scope Delivered

Reference `docs/planning/SCOPE-STATEMENT.md` — do not rewrite scope here, just confirm:

```
□ All in-scope items in SCOPE-STATEMENT.md have been completed
□ Items deferred/moved to next phase are recorded below (Open Items)
□ No scope changes bypassed change control
```

---

## Deliverables

| # | Deliverable | Format/Location | Status |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Source code | {repo URL + branch/tag} | {Delivered / N/A per contract} |
| 2 | Release notes | `docs/pm/CHANGE-LOG.md` or separate file | {Delivered} |
| 3 | User manual | {location} | {Delivered / N/A} |
| 4 | Technical documentation (API, architecture) | `docs/architecture/`, `docs/database/` | {Delivered} |
| 5 | Maintenance phase information | `docs/dev-docs/HANDOVER.md` | {Delivered} |
| 6 | Credentials & access (delivered via secure channel, NOT in this document) | {password manager / vault} | {Delivered} |
| 7 | Training/knowledge transfer | {session date, who attended} | {Completed / N/A} |

> The "Format/Location" column for credentials MUST NOT contain the credential values themselves.
> BAST is a document that may be stored long-term and shared broadly; credentials in it are
> a security leak waiting to happen.

## Legal Review Sign-off (required for `handover_formality: legal`)

> Skip this section for `none`, `email`, and `full` handover formality.
> For `legal` handover formality, this section must be completed by a qualified human — not the agent.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Reviewed by | {Full name} |
| Role / Authority | {e.g. Legal Counsel, Procurement Manager, Company Secretary} |
| Organization | {…} |
| Review date | {YYYY-MM-DD} |
| Scope of review | {e.g. contract compliance, IP assignment, warranty terms, liability clauses} |
| Outstanding legal concerns | {None / List here — any concern listed here blocks Gate C until resolved} |

**After BAST is signed:**
1. Save as a file (not just in email/chat) — in `docs/pm/BAST.md` and/or a separate PDF
2. Update `docs/pm/PROJECT-CLOSURE-REPORT.md` §Deliverables with this BAST date
3. Start warranty period (if applicable) — record the end date in the team calendar
